correctness.rationale: The primary classification was inspected in its original open full text (Theorem 1.2(ii), Corollary 2.4, Section 3). Three candidate area ratios are independently reconstructed using similar triangles and the cosine law. For angle threshold theta, the shortest-side lower bound is exact, and the remaining minimax reduces to an increasing curve meeting the maximum of two strictly decreasing curves. Algebraic factoring produces the unique switch root u^4+u^3=1; monotonicity gives the quartic branch, all quantifiers, and uniqueness. Explicit one-sided derivatives verify a genuine corner. CHECK.py corroborates the derived equality shapes for 600 angles and checks thousands of feasible parameter points. These finite tests are not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The minimum angle is a standard geometric quality parameter for triangle shape/mesh fatness. The invariant measures the maximum area retained when a host triangle is replaced by an inscribed isosceles triangle. A sharp worst-case guarantee across all such shape-constrained triangles is a natural geometric approximation constant, not an arbitrary dimension or test slice. The complete continuum profile has two algebraically distinct regimes, a sharp unexpected 41.83-degree corner where competing inscribed constructions exchange control, and unique extremizing triangle shapes. The unconstrained sharp 1/sqrt(2) guarantee is a nonattained limit. These facts supply an interpretable classification beyond numerical accuracy or a routine formula evaluation.
